## Description {#details}

<p>This file defines the little GraphTraits&lt;X&gt; template class that should be specialized by classes that want to be iteratable by generic graph iterators.</p>


<p>This file also defines the marker class Inverse that is used to iterate over graphs in a graph defined, inverse ordering...</p>
